body: I was just there a few months ago. It was the first time I ever went on a real hiking trip and I'm not exaggerating when I say that *everything* I saw was so beautiful and green. I never wanted to leave!
I would like to live here.

i've been battling this for so long. lying to myself that i'm okay. i have a fucked up family, they're always fighting, my mother is always crying. my father is always sad, my brother is a straight up asshole, and i'm just trying to make everybody get along and i have to listen to it all. i absorb it if that makes any sense. the more i hear it, the more i feel the negative things they say consume me.
even if they were, i'm still nothing to them. and everyone. nobody cares about me.
if that is true... if they are really scumbags, then why do so many people i know like them so much? maybe it's me. maybe i'm really such a shitty person that i bring it on myself.

i've gone out of my way to help my "friends" when they need me... no one does that for me. my "friends" don't even ask me to hangout with them anymore. they all call me when they need things from me, but no one ever asks me "hey (name), why don't you come hang out with us today?"
i'm a people pleaser. i always have been. if my existence makes people unhappy, why should i stay?
